title: PackSense AI Prototype Assumptions — Internal Engineering Baseline
notes: Qualitative food-profile attributes used in Phase 1 prototype. All values are working engineering assumptions pending experimental validation. DO NOT treat as experimentally verified data.

title: Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulations, 2018
publisher: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
notes: FSSAI Packaging Regulations 2018. Governs food-contact material requirements in India. Specific material listings must be checked against the current Schedule. This source is referenced for regulatory screening; referencing this source does NOT confer automatic approval for any specific material-food combination.

title: IS 9845: Method for Determination of Overall Migration of Constituents of Plastics Materials and Articles Intended to Come into Contact with Foodstuffs
notes: BIS test method for overall migration from plastics to food. Relevant for regulatory compliance screening of plastic packaging materials.

title: Food Packaging: Principles and Practice, 3rd Edition
notes: Standard reference textbook for food packaging science. General principles on barrier properties, MAP, respiration, and packaging selection. Specific numerical values require cross-referencing with this source and manufacturer data sheets.

title: Packaging Material Selection for Shelf-Life Extension: A Review
publisher: Comprehensive Reviews in Food Science and Food Safety
notes: Review article on packaging selection considerations for shelf-life extension. Used to inform qualitative risk and requirement rules. Individual OTR/WVTR values cited in reviews must be validated against original sources and specific material grades.

title: Modified Atmosphere Packaging of Fresh Produce: A Scientific Review
notes: Reference for MAP principles applied to fresh produce including tomato. Respiration rates, O2/CO2 balance principles, and MAP film selection criteria. Numerical values in this prototype are placeholder ranges requiring validation against specific cultivar, temperature, and storage data.
